points.title: Twelve shipwrights
points.body: All of them still building boats for a living.

points.title: One working slipway
points.body: Watch a launch on the Friday high tide.

props.heading: A yard with a long memory.
props.headingRest: North Quay has built boats since 1891.

content.text: The yard's crew teach every class. Between them they have launched more than three hundred boats, from dinghies to pilot cutters.
